accessed_api_types.purpose: av_file_map() calls fstat() on the file it has just opened to read its size, then maps that many bytes and returns the buffer and size to its caller.
accessed_api_types.rationale: av_file_map() in libavutil/file.c is public API that maps a file the app names, it is the only code in libavutil that calls fstat(), and nothing in libavutil, libavcodec, libavformat or libswresample calls av_file_map() for its own purposes.
